digest.component_or_area: rebar/host CloudWatch alarms and observability metrics publishing
propositions: Eleven rebar/host CloudWatch alarms are configured with treat_missing_data=notBreaching despite their publishers unconditionally emitting heartbeat zero-deltas every 5min, so missing data indicates publisher death (timer crash, host down, credential revocation) but is misinterpreted as health.

mirror_out_of_sync has a fail-open defect where its publish sits inside a guard that emits nothing on Gerrit REST or git ls-remote failures, permanently muting the alarm while the host lives and GitHub main drifts undetected.
replication_errors and review_interrupts_signal_unavailable mute themselves on live hosts when log rotation, file moves, or transient publish failures occur, leaving no compensating signal.

Alarms flipped to treat_missing_data=breaching but left at evaluation_periods=1 will flap on normal timer jitter (observed ~22 of 24 periods present over 2 hours), unless paired with evaluation_periods>=3 and datapoints_to_alarm>=2.

The guard test and Terraform rule now enforce: every namespace=rebar/host alarm must set treat_missing_data=breaching with evaluation_periods>=3 and effective datapoints>=2, OR carry an explicit opt-out marker documenting its compensating control.
